title: Hypercontractivity of a uniform sign
statement: Let $S$ be the two-element set of signs $\{-1,1\}$, with the uniform probability measure, and let $X(s)=s$. For every pair of real numbers $a,b$, the uniform $L^2$ norm of $a+bX/\sqrt{3}$ is at most the uniform $L^{4/3}$ norm of $a+bX$.
